newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News finds support after two-year low.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News finds support after two-year low.

text.p: The shares of Rupert Murdoch's media conglomerate News Corp Ltd found support in Australian trading on Monday after briefing hitting a two-year low.
News Corp shares closed 13.2 cents up at A$6.16 with 11.79 million shares traded worth A$73.45 million. News Corp earlier hit a low of A$5.95, its lowest level since March 1995.
Shares in the media gaint fell 10 percent last week after it announced a US$1.35 billion deal to buy U.S. television, radio and marketing group Heritage Media Corp.
News Corp preference shares ended seven cents lower at A$5.15 with 3.74 million shares traded.
Most of the trade was handled by J.B. Were & Son, a brokage firm close to the Murdoch camp, brokers said.
"Most of it was bought in bits and pieces around the market," said a broker at J.B. Were who did not want to be identified.
